CustomField.description: Master switch for resilient retrieval (SupportRetrievalService.retrieveResilient). When true, a first retrieval pass that comes back below Retrieval_Distill_Trigger_Score__c triggers ONE Models chat call that distils the raw case into a focused search query; retrieval re-runs on it and keeps whichever pass is stronger. Spends the extra call ONLY on cases that would otherwise miss the draft floor. Default false -> retrieveResilient behaves identically to retrieve (no extra callout). OPT-IN: leave off until the labeled eval shows the customer-phrasing gap closing without regressing other buckets.
CustomField.label: Retrieval Query Distill Enabled
